name: Harbinger
description: Born from a destroyed predictive analytics AI. Inhabits data augments and generates probability assessments for events that haven't happened yet — displayed as fleeting numbers overlaid on the user's vision.
observed_behavior: Projects percentage values onto objects and people in the user's visual field. The percentages correlate weakly but consistently with negative outcomes. A person at 87% is having a bad day.
story_hooks: The user sees 99% on a building they're about to enter. They don't go in. The building collapses an hour later.
